components.name: Embedded Linux Base Platform
components.description: 임베디드 리눅스 배포 기반 계층. 커널, 부트로더, 루트 파일시스템을 포함한다.

components.name: Eclipse Mosquitto
components.description: 엣지 계층의 MQTT 브로커. 현장 데이터를 상위 시스템으로 발행한다.

components.name: Dropbear SSH
components.description: 경량 SSH 서버. 현장 엔지니어의 원격 진단 셸 접속 경로를 제공한다.

components.name: Linux Kernel
components.description: 장비 운영체제 커널. 스케줄링, 메모리 관리, 디바이스 드라이버 계층을 제공한다.

components.name: Das U-Boot
components.description: 부트로더. 펌웨어 이미지 무결성 검증과 커널 로딩을 담당한다.

components.name: libpcap
components.description: 현장 진단용 패킷 캡처 라이브러리. 프로토콜 트러블슈팅에 사용된다.

components.name: edgeAggregator Redundancy Management Module
components.description: 이중화 쌍 간 상태 동기화와 무중단 절체를 관리하는 모듈.

components.name: edgeAggregator Firmware Update Agent
components.description: 서명 검증을 포함한 펌웨어 이미지 수신, 검증, 활성화 절차를 수행하는 업데이트 에이전트.

components.name: edgeAggregator Diagnostics and Event Logger
components.description: 장비 상태 이벤트, 진단 코드, 감사 로그를 수집하고 보관하는 모듈.

components.name: edgeAggregator Embedded Web Configuration UI
components.description: 브라우저 기반 설정 및 상태 조회 화면을 제공하는 내장 웹 애플리케이션.

components.name: edgeAggregator I/O Scanner Module
components.description: 원격 I/O 및 필드 모듈과의 주기적 데이터 교환을 담당하는 스캐너 모듈.

components.name: edgeAggregator Alarm and Event Engine
components.description: 임계값 감시, 알람 우선순위 판정, 확인/해제 상태 관리를 수행하는 엔진.

components.name: OPC UA Server Stack
components.description: OPC UA 주소공간, 구독, 보안 채널을 제공하는 서버 스택.

components.name: MQTT Client Stack
components.description: 엣지 데이터 발행을 위한 MQTT 클라이언트 스택.

components.name: Modbus/TCP Protocol Stack
components.description: Modbus TCP 서버/클라이언트 기능. 레지스터 및 코일 접근 요청을 처리한다.

vulnerabilities.description: Format string vulnerability in Dropbear SSH before 2016.74 allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code via format string specifiers in the (1) username or (2) host argument.

analysis.detail: Identified by SBOM component matching. VEX adjudication (exploitability in this ICS deployment) not yet performed.

vulnerabilities.description: The dropbearconvert command in Dropbear SSH before 2016.74 allows attackers to execute arbitrary code via a crafted OpenSSH key file.

analysis.detail: Identified by SBOM component matching. VEX adjudication (exploitability in this ICS deployment) not yet performed.

vulnerabilities.description: nfs_lookup_reply in net/nfs.c in Das U-Boot through 2022.04 (and through 2022.07-rc2) has an unbounded memcpy with a failed length check, leading to a buffer overflow. NOTE: this issue exists because of an incorrect fix for CVE-2019-14196.

analysis.detail: Identified by SBOM component matching. VEX adjudication (exploitability in this ICS deployment) not yet performed.

vulnerabilities.description: The dbclient in Dropbear SSH before 2016.74 allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code via a crafted (1) -m or (2) -c argument.

analysis.detail: Identified by SBOM component matching. VEX adjudication (exploitability in this ICS deployment) not yet performed.

vulnerabilities.description: The command-line argument parser in tcpdump before 4.99.0 has a buffer overflow in tcpdump.c:read_infile(). To trigger this vulnerability the attacker needs to create a 4GB file on the local filesystem and to specify the file name as the value of the -F command-line argument of tcpdump.

analysis.detail: Identified by SBOM component matching. VEX adjudication (exploitability in this ICS deployment) not yet performed.

vulnerabilities.description: Das U-Boot through 2020.01 allows attackers to bypass verified boot restrictions and subsequently boot arbitrary images by providing a crafted FIT image to a system configured to boot the default configuration.

analysis.detail: Identified by SBOM component matching. VEX adjudication (exploitability in this ICS deployment) not yet performed.

vulnerabilities.description: The boot loader in Das U-Boot before 2021.04-rc2 mishandles a modified FIT.

analysis.detail: Identified by SBOM component matching. VEX adjudication (exploitability in this ICS deployment) not yet performed.

vulnerabilities.description: fs/seq_file.c in the Linux kernel 3.16 through 5.13.x before 5.13.4 does not properly restrict seq buffer allocations, leading to an integer overflow, an Out-of-bounds Write, and escalation to root by an unprivileged user, aka CID-8cae8cd89f05.

analysis.detail: Identified by SBOM component matching. VEX adjudication (exploitability in this ICS deployment) not yet performed.

vulnerabilities.description: A flaw was found in the way the "flags" member of the new pipe buffer structure was lacking proper initialization in copy_page_to_iter_pipe and push_pipe functions in the Linux kernel and could thus contain stale values. An unprivileged local user could use this flaw to write to pages in the page cache backed by read only files and as such escalate their privileges on the system.

analysis.detail: Identified by SBOM component matching. VEX adjudication (exploitability in this ICS deployment) not yet performed.

vulnerabilities.description: In Mosquitto before 2.0.16, a memory leak occurs when clients send v5 CONNECT packets with a will message that contains invalid property types.

analysis.detail: Identified by SBOM component matching. VEX adjudication (exploitability in this ICS deployment) not yet performed.

vulnerabilities.description: sf-pcapng.c in libpcap before 1.9.1 does not properly validate the PHB header length before allocating memory.

analysis.detail: Identified by SBOM component matching. VEX adjudication (exploitability in this ICS deployment) not yet performed.

vulnerabilities.description: In Mosquitto before 2.0.16, excessive memory is allocated based on malicious initial packets that are not CONNECT packets.

analysis.detail: Identified by SBOM component matching. VEX adjudication (exploitability in this ICS deployment) not yet performed.
